doc: A kind of fence (design/planner.md, Fences), as a config entry: its style, height, colours, and how its line is laid (post spacing, straightening), so a picket fence, a split rail, a wattle hurdle, a hedge, a low stone wall, and iron railings are data.

fields.name: style
fields.doc: How it is built: pickets, rails, split rails, wattle hurdles, a hedge, a low dry-stone wall, iron railings, living willow woven in diamonds, upright stone slabs, or bundled reeds.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Pickets, rails, hurdles, leaves, stones, or bars.

fields.name: thickness
fields.doc: Its thickness (a hedge's or wall's), metres.

fields.name: module_m
fields.doc: Post spacing along a link, metres (a link is 3 m).
